EffArea_press_20.description: Components and Cladding Pressure in psf at an effective area of 20ft2

EffArea_press_50.description: Components and Cladding Pressure in psf at an effective area of 50ft2

EffArea_press_500.description: Components and Cladding Pressure in psf at an effective area of 500ft2

EffArea_press_700.description: DEPRECATED and NO LONGER POPULATED: use Mwfrs_press instead. Despite the name this was never a Components and Cladding effective-area pressure. Declared nullable so producers omit it entirely.

EffArea_press_1000.description: Components and Cladding Pressure in psf at an effective area of 1000ft2, per ASCE 7-16 Fig 30.3-2A

Mwfrs_press.description: MWFRS Pressure in psf, per ASCE 7-16 Fig 27.3-1 for roofs and walls and Sec 27.3.4 GCpn for parapets. Per ASCE 7-16 Sec 30.2.3 this may only be used where the element's ACTUAL tributary area is at least 700ft2, never based on effective wind area.
